flat_speed_m_s.citation_or_assumption: Walking speed on level ground. Demo assumption chosen by the developers; not derived from NASA EVA data and not a certified value.

slope_time_penalty.citation_or_assumption: Time per metre is multiplied by (1 + penalty × |grade|); 6 makes a 10 % grade 60 % slower. Demo assumption chosen by the developers; not derived from NASA EVA data and not a certified value.

max_slope_deg.citation_or_assumption: Planning cells steeper than this are not entered. A scenario rule, not a suit or safety limit. Demo assumption chosen by the developers; not derived from NASA EVA data and not a certified value.

overhead_s.citation_or_assumption: Fixed time for egress, ingress and checks. Demo assumption chosen by the developers; not derived from NASA EVA data and not a certified value.

base_power_w.citation_or_assumption: Continuous equipment load for the whole EVA. Demo assumption chosen by the developers; not derived from NASA EVA data and not a certified value.

consumable_rate_travel_per_h.citation_or_assumption: Oxygen use while walking. Demo assumption chosen by the developers; not derived from NASA EVA data and not a certified value.

consumable_rate_activity_per_h.citation_or_assumption: Oxygen use while working at a site or during overhead. Demo assumption chosen by the developers; not derived from NASA EVA data and not a certified value.
